items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: when I first joined him, we used to play quite a bit for long parties

ctx.x: And other places that Ory might have played when he was... When you first joined him.

Well, I'd say, when I first joined him, we used to play quite a bit for long parties, you know. Private affairs. And played lots of time out to West Stand and out to Millenburg, you know. Oh yeah, those camps. Camps, you know, Sundays, you know, those different clubs, you know. They'd have their... Go out there at 9 o'clock in the morning, stay till 6 o'clock, you understand. Then come right on in and go down to Economy Hall. Yeah. Play till 4 o'clock in the morning. Leave home 9 o'clock, then get back home, hold…
